title: Architecture artefact — the principles catalogue (PF-1)
body:
# Architecture artefact — T9 TOGAF ADM capability index (retrospective, 2026-11-22)

## Metadata

The project's artefact index carries the seven Phase A–D artefacts this rework publishes, each bound to the adopted standard's `artifact_type`: the Stakeholder Map (A, PSA, matrix), the Driver/Goal/Objective Catalog (A, PSA, catalog), the Requirements Catalog (A, PSA, catalog), the Solution Concept Diagram (A, PSA, diagram), the Business Capability Map (B, HLD, diagram), the Data Entity/Data Component Catalog (C, HLD, catalog) and the Technology Standards Catalog (D, HLD, catalog). The owner is the programme architect (`conveyor-e2e`); the reviewer is the Architecture Board (`conveyor-architecture-board`); the review date is 2026-11-22; the related project is T9.

## Entries

The index's per-artefact entries are the artefact rows themselves: nine stakeholder cells, eleven driver/goal rows, twelve requirements, twelve solution-concept components and edges, eleven capability rows, twelve data components and twelve technology standards. Each artefact's own body carries its metadata, entries, links and document sections, and the rows are queryable through the repository actions.

## Links

The seven artefacts form one chain: the stakeholder map and the driver catalog derive from SPEC_V2 §8.1 and §12 T9; the requirements catalog realizes the gate clauses; the solution concept realizes the requirements as components and edges; the business capability map derives from the requirements and solution concept; the data entity catalog realizes the solution concept's components; the technology standards catalog fixes the rules the data catalog depends on. The delivery contract governs the set.

## Document

Each artefact is published as a typed `architecture_artifact` row with its body as the document, under the T9 delivery contract and the T9 row of `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12. The approval is the Board's; this index is retrospective. Open findings v1-p81-5 (row integrity) and v1-p81-4 (draft Board) bear on the repository these artefacts live in, not on their content.
